summaryZh: 我全面掌管集團跨國多雲基礎設施、資訊安全體系與海量大數據平台，統籌跨兩岸三地的技術架構研發與維運治理。任內主導集團核心業務自傳統虛擬機全面向雲原生（Cloud-Native）架構演進，全面推進 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 容器化改造與自動化 CI/CD 流水線，將新功能發布與環境交付週期縮短一倍以上，達成部署效率提升 100% 的突破性躍進。在資料層現代化方面，我率領架構團隊將龐大且高負載的核心交易與遊戲數據，平滑遷移至 MongoDB Atlas 全託管跨國分散式叢集，建構兼具全球即時讀寫分離與自動水平擴展之高可用架構。面對海外多區百萬級玩家跨國連線的極端高併發峰值與巨量突發流量，透過自我修復（Self-Healing）機制與跨區域容災備援設計，達成跨國服務 100% 零中斷（Zero Outage）的極致可靠性指標。同時，我深度推行 FinOps 雲端成本治理與運算資源動態調度，建立精準的資源計量與持續優化模型，在支撐全球業務量高速增長的同時，實現多雲總持有成本（TCO）實質降低 30%。在資安與合規層面，我主導全面落實 ISO 27001 資訊安全管理系統（ISMS）與零信任（Zero Trust）架構，建立自動化靜態與動態安全檢測關卡，兼顧高敏捷交付與企業級資安防禦。此一現代化雲端轉型專案更獲 Google Cloud 官方評選為全球客戶成功案例並進行專題專訪，成為亞太地區數位娛樂與高併發架構轉型的旗艦標竿。
summaryEn: Directing group-wide multi-cloud infrastructure, information security governance, and big data platforms across multinational operations, I spearheaded the comprehensive migration from legacy virtual machines to cloud-native architectures. By driving Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) containerization and automated CI/CD pipelines, we accelerated deployment frequency and halved environment delivery cycles, achieving a 100% boost in deployment efficiency. For data layer modernization, I led the seamless migration of mission-critical transactional and real-time gaming data to fully managed MongoDB Atlas global distributed clusters, architecting real-time read/write splitting and elastic auto-scaling. Confronting millions of concurrent cross-border connections during peak bursts, our self-healing mechanisms and multi-region disaster recovery ensured an uncompromising 100% Zero Outage track record. Concurrently, I implemented FinOps cloud financial governance and dynamic resource provisioning, reducing multi-cloud Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) by 30% amidst rapid global business growth. On security and compliance, I governed enterprise-wide ISO 27001 ISMS certification, Zero Trust perimeters, and automated DevSecOps gates. This flagship cloud modernization initiative was internationally recognized by Google Cloud as a Global Customer Success Story with dedicated case study features.
